name: Hajimete no Miyuki
source:
Miyuki lost her virginity by her childhood friend, Hajime. Then, Hajime's demands on her were escalated into actions at anywhere he pleased; in the classroom, in the gym equipment room. She was repeated assaulted, at the mercy of Hajime's sexual desire.

This is a story of Miyuki who was assaulted in her school uniform or shorts.
